item.title: Iyarashi Kurashi ~Relief Doll~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SOUTH TREE
  • 発売日: 2022-05-10
  • スコア: 5.7700000000000005/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 癒らし暮らし ～Relief Doll～
  • 英語名: Iyarashi Kurashi Relief Doll

あらすじ

This is a communication game where an android takes care of a lonely heroine and helps to heal her both physically and emotionally. The game includes conversations, cuddles, head pats, bath time, and even intimate moments in bed, all while fulfilling the heroine’s requests and providing relief from the stresses of living alone as a working adult.

item.title: Chikan no Shoudou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SOUTH TREE
  • 発売日: 2016-12-05
  • スコア: 6.29/10 (43 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 痴漢の衝動
  • 英語名: Chikan no Shoudou

あらすじ

This is a simulation game where the player can engage in molestation towards a quiet, well-developed girl they meet at a deserted bus stop in a rural town during the night. The game allows the player to touch various parts of the girl’s body, and even remove her clothes while being careful not to be caught by other passengers or the girl’s friends on the bus. As time passes and the number of passengers decrease, the player can take more daring actions until reaching the final stop.
